1. To make a linear separator in feature space correspond to a nonlinear rule in the original $x$.
2. $K(x,x')=\phi(x)^\top\phi(x')$.
3. Replace feature-space inner products by $K$ evaluated on original inputs, avoiding explicit $\phi$.
4. $K(x,x')=\exp(-\|x-x'\|^2/(2\sigma^{2}))$ (equivalent forms with a bandwidth constant).
5. $f(x)=\sum_{i\in\mathrm{SV}}\mu_i y_i K(x_i,x)+b$.
